aboutBody:
I’m a software engineer with 3+ years of enterprise application development experience, building backend and web systems with Java/Spring Boot and C#/.NET. My work spans REST APIs, database optimization, integration testing, and software delivery.

Outside my enterprise work, I build and operate cloud and containerized systems using AWS, GCP, Terraform, Docker, and K3s. My homelab is where I explore observability, connected devices, and the practical details of running applications.

I’m especially interested in cloud-native web applications that use AI for monitoring, operational insights, and controlled automation. My infrastructure monitoring agent combines live telemetry with LLM APIs, with human approval before infrastructure actions execute.
